question: Which one of the following is the primary component of natural gas?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Methane.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The main component of natural gas is methane.**
 
• It contains mainly methane, ethane, propane, butane, and so on.
 
• Apart from this it also contains ethane, propane, and heavier hydrocarbons.
 
• It also contains small amounts of nitrogen, carbon dioxide, hydrogen sulphide, and trace amounts of water.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Natural gas** is a mixture of hydrocarbons.

 
 
• Methane is around 98% of the natural gas mixture.
 
• Natural gas is widely used as a fuel and a raw material.
 
• They are fossil energy sources that were generated years ago beneath the earth's surface.
 
• These natural gasses contain natural gas liquids and non-hydrocarbon gases.
 
• Oxygen will make confusion for the candidates.
 
• Oxygen is the most abundant element or gas in the atmosphere.
